buildManifest.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0

settings.ownership: Per-operation autorelease pool drain is inside the API timer; retained document setup/warm render and verification are outside

scope.apiCosts: Actual Swift APIs include C FFI, binary graph crossings, intrinsic JSON encoding/decoding, native validation/import, fresh C registry on parse, and mutable publication on render.
scope.lifetime: parseMutable -> snapshot -> no-op apply -> render -> close, including owned values disposal
scope.excluded: Process/module startup, NDJSON control, output hashing/verification, AppKit/DOM decoding/painting and GPU work
scope.comparisons: No JS ratio, allocator comparison or subtraction from native component measurements
scope.externalLoad: Unrelated xctest processes are recorded, not stopped or used to block the run. Results describe a shared host, not a globally idle machine.
